Subject: Ethane election for September 2000

HPL will be kept whole with respect to ethane recoveries from the Big Cowboy 
gas being processed at the King Ranch Gas Plant during the month of 
September.  This election will reduct the shrinkage percentage from 20% of 
the inlet MMBtu's to 15% of the inlet MMBtu's.
